messages:
ada: quick sync on pin metadata size. we've seen latency spikes when resolver fetches large release blobs on cold routes. proposal: add a tiny on-pin shim called `pin_key` (<=64 bytes) that encodes routing-critical tokens. router only reads `pin_key` and ignores release_url unless asked.
maria: sounds promising. what goes into `pin_key`?
chris: `rollout_id|cohort|compat_buckets|stability` — pipe-delimited, compact. example: `r2026-03-21|canary-7|tok-v1,kv-v2|exp`
linh: +1 but we should spell out semantics. `compat_buckets` is derived from catalog mapping of detailed tags -> bucket id (small ints). so pin remains small and canonical.
nate: how do we handle introspection? ops needs owner and eval links. mirror a short owner id and an `inspect_url` on pin (optional) but keep it short: owner like `u:alice` and url only set for non-prod.
maria: telemetry: we want the pin_key exploded in traces as fields for filtering. router can emit `pin_key.*` tags. also prefer pin TTL to be explicit: `expires_at` ISO8601 or `ttl_seconds`.
chris: fallback policy: router will attempt: 1) exact pin_key match (same rollout_id) 2) same cohort 3) shared compat_bucket 4) stable tagged model. We should include `compat_bucket_priority` ordering implicitly by bucket numeric id.
linh: migration: runtime must tolerate missing `pin_key` and default to old behaviour. new resolver will synthesize pin_key from release manifest if absent, but we should prefer on-pin value for speed.
nate: security note: if we include `inspect_url` it must be signed short-lived for public buckets. otherwise stick to internal release_url in manifest.
ada: (typo)
ops-bot: rollout started r2026-03-21 (cohort: canary-7) on pool-5 — smoke: flaky, metrics: p95 token latency +15% :warning:
maria: operational checklist: 1) RFC to add fields: `pin_key` (string), `expires_at` (string), `owner_id` (string, optional), `inspect_url` (string, optional). 2) define `pin_key` grammar and catalog mapping for compat_buckets. 3) runtime: read `pin_key` only for routing; silently ignore unknown fields. 4) require `inspect_url` for non-stable rollouts. 5) trace middleware to parse `pin_key` into tags. objections?
chris: +1, prefer `ttl_seconds` instead of `expires_at` for faster checks, but both ok if we standardize.
linh: +1. small perf note: store `pin_key` in resolver cache with TTL aligned to pin ttl.
nate: +1. i'll add signing rules for inspect_url.
maria: i'll draft the grammar and a tiny shim that builds pin_key from existing manifests for migration. aiming for doc+PR next week. thanks all :rocket:
